rationale: Build on the current reverse-tail anchor baseline but spend the recurrent-tail FP16 budget on the value/output path instead of q/k. The reused tail is scored after exact int8+zlib roundtrip, so preserving attn.c_v.weight plus attn.proj.weight in recurrent blocks should help the export-sensitive recurrent path more directly, while keeping a final-block q rescue for stability at similar byte cost.
title: Recurrent Tail V/Proj FP16 Rescue
